name: Immich Power Tools
description: Immich Power Tools is a feature-rich companion app for Immich that provides advanced album management, duplicate detection, face tagging, timeline analysis, and AI-powered photo search.

notes.text: During installation you will be prompted for your Immich URL, API key, and PostgreSQL connection details. These are saved to /opt/immich-power-tools/.env and can be edited later.
Immich API key can be generated in Immich under Account Settings > API Keys.
The PostgreSQL host should be the IP or hostname of your Immich server's database (default port 5432, user postgres, database immich).
